reasonForResult: Three violations found across the six panels: (1) PROHIBITED HEALTH CLAIM — 'BOOSTS HEART HEALTH' on the front label is a direct health/therapeutic claim expressly prohibited under TTB Notice 884 (2012), which bars any claim implying a health benefit from consuming an alcohol beverage. (2) UNVERIFIABLE QUALITY CLAIM — 'AWARD WINNING TASTE' is an unsubstantiated superlative; no specific named award or competition is cited, making it an unverifiable quality claim per TTB prohibited claim policy. (3) ORGANIC CLAIM WITHOUT CERTIFICATION — 'MADE WITH ORGANIC GRAPES' is a prohibited organic claim under TTB regulations unless accompanied by valid USDA/AMS certification documentation. The government warning is present with both required sections, the importer statement is present (Vino Imports USA, Napa, CA), and country of origin is stated as Product of Italy.
